signal_cue_instantly.param: table[ $id = 'drjele_diplomacy_xp_factor', $category = 'Diplomacy Agents', $name = 'Agent experience multiplier', $mouseover = 'Multiplies the experience an agent earns from an action. Vanilla is 1x: 1-15 points per action, 400 in total to reach Spymaster.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 1, $args = table[$min = 1, $max = 20, $step = 1, $suffix = 'x'], $callback = OnXpFactorChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_diplomacy_injured_xp_percent', $category = 'Diplomacy Agents', $name = 'Experience when injured', $mouseover = 'An agent that comes back injured gets this percent of a normal no-risk experience roll, split between both skills. Vanilla gives nothing, so 0 is off. A failed action the agent survives already pays experience.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 0, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 100, $step = 10, $suffix = ' %'], $callback = OnInjuredXpChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_diplomacy_risk_percent', $category = 'Diplomacy Agents', $name = 'Agent risk', $mouseover = 'Scales the injury and death chances a failed risky action rolls against. 100 is vanilla (up to 70 percent injury, 30 percent death), 0 means an agent can never be hurt or killed.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 100, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 100, $step = 5, $suffix = ' %'], $callback = OnRiskChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_diplomacy_agents_can_die', $category = 'Diplomacy Agents', $name = 'Agents can die', $mouseover = 'On is vanilla: a failed risky action can kill the agent outright, up to a 30 percent chance. Off caps the worst it can do at an injury, without touching how often one happens.', $type = 'button', $default = 1, $callback = OnAgentsCanDieChanged, ]

table[ $id = 'drjele_diplomacy_agent_gender', $category = 'Diplomacy Agents', $name = 'Agent gender (0 any, 1 female, 2 male)', $mouseover = 'Which agents factions put up for hire from now on. Agents you already know keep the gender they were born with - fire one and the faction sends a new one. The Paranid factions and the Boron ignore it - the game holds no female model for either race.', $type = 'slidercell', $default = 0, $args = table[$min = 0, $max = 2, $step = 1], $callback = OnGenderChanged, ]
